I will still do close to what worked for me before. On my 9 mu, I will keep wheat-maize as the main way, because with well water I can hold the yield steadier, and that is what matters most for feeding the family and making money. I have only primary school, so I do not make it too complicated. I look at what did well around me, what the seed dealer says, and what my own field showed last year. Wheat and maize are my main crops, so I will put most land there. Cotton takes more watching and more picking labor, so I will only keep a smaller piece for cash. Fertilizer is expensive, but if I cut too hard and the yield drops, that loss is worse, so I will feed wheat and maize a bit heavier and keep cotton in the middle. With 9 mu, I can still manage mostly with family labor, and with well irrigation I will water at the key times instead of gambling on rain.
